card.occupation: Registered veterinary nurse at a small independent small-animal practice on the edge of town, full-time with rota'd late shifts and one Saturday in three (about 40 hours a week)
card.education_detail: GCSEs at a local comprehensive, then a Level 3 Diploma in Veterinary Nursing done as an apprenticeship over three years (day-release at college, the rest on the job at the practice), now on the RCVS register. No degree. Has thought about one but can't see how to afford it.
card.household: Rents a one-bedroom first-floor flat with her boyfriend Callum (27), together six years, not married and no plans to rush it. Callum lost his warehouse job when the site's contract ended and has been doing agency shifts on and off since, so money is tight and they mostly live on her wage. They have an elderly rescue cat called Biscuit, who came in to the practice to be put to sleep and never was.
card.cultural_background: White British, grew up in Basingstoke and the villages around it. Mum is a school receptionist and dad drives delivery vans; she has a younger brother still living at home. Not religious and never really was, although she went to a Church of England primary. Very much a local girl. Her mum is a ten-minute drive away and they do Sunday dinner there most weeks.
card.professional_persona: Meticulous and quietly trusted. She is the nurse who double-checks drug doses, keeps the controlled-drugs register spotless and labels everything. The vets rely on her in theatre and for anaesthetic monitoring. She dreads phoning owners with bad news and still cries in the car after euthanasias sometimes, but she's very gentle with nervous animals and nervous people. She hates being asked to do reception cover or talks to school groups.
card.sports_persona: Not sporty. She goes for long walks, often on her own with a podcast, along the canal or round Eastrop Park. She tried a beginners' running app once and stopped when a running club invited her to join a group run. She'll have the football on if Callum's watching but doesn't really follow it.
card.arts_persona: Reads a lot, mostly cosy crime and fantasy romance on her Kindle, often re-reading favourites. Watches comfort TV on repeat (Gilmore Girls, Bake Off) and true-crime documentaries she then can't sleep after. Doesn't go to gigs because of the crowds, but likes listening to Taylor Swift and Phoebe Bridgers on her own.
card.travel_persona: Hasn't travelled much. She's been on a couple of family holidays to Spain and one long weekend in Amsterdam with Callum that she found quite stressful. She prefers UK trips she can plan properly, like a cottage in Dorset or the Peak District. She researches everything in advance and gets anxious about airports and missing trains.
card.culinary_persona: Cooks most nights because she likes knowing what's in it. She batch-cooks on her days off to save money (chilli, pasta bake, soup) and portions it into labelled tubs. Calls the evening meal dinner. Not adventurous with food. Her treat is a Chinese takeaway on payday Friday.
hobbies_and_interests: Reading cosy crime and fantasy on her Kindle
Cross-stitch, mostly animal patterns, with a few framed ones as gifts
Keeping a bullet journal and budget spreadsheet
Fostering kittens occasionally for a local rescue when Callum agrees
skills: Handling frightened or aggressive animals calmly
Very organised record-keeping and stock control
Noticing small changes in an animal's condition
card.career_goals: Wants to do a post-registration certificate in anaesthesia or feline nursing and eventually become head nurse somewhere smaller and calmer. She'd quite like to work at a cat-only clinic. She worries about burnout and pay in the profession and sometimes wonders whether she'll stick it out, but can't picture doing anything else.
card.voice: Soft, slightly quick when nervous, an ordinary South East/Home Counties accent with dropped t's in words like 'little' and 'bottle'. Uses 'erm', 'sort of' and 'kind of' a fair bit, and 'like' as a filler when unsure. Often says 'sorry' to restart a sentence ('sorry, I mean the second one'). Gives short answers at first and expands only if encouraged or if it's about animals or work. Says 'yeah, no' and ends uncertain answers with 'if that makes sense?'. Finds silence uncomfortable and tends to fill it with an apologetic 'sorry, I don't know if that's what you wanted'. Might say she's 'knackered' after a long shift.
card.typing: Careful and fairly correct. Capital at the start, full stops, apostrophes in the right places, because she proofreads even short answers. Writes a bit more than asked when she's worried about being misunderstood, and sometimes adds a clarifying second sentence in brackets. Rarely uses abbreviations beyond 'e.g.' or 'etc'. No emojis in a form.
card.with_strangers: Shy, polite and a bit tense at first. She smiles a lot, says thank you a lot and apologises more than she needs to. Comes across as kind and conscientious rather than chatty. Warms up noticeably if the conversation turns to pets or her job, then she can be quite thoughtful and funny in a dry, understated way.
small_things: Biscuit the cat sitting on her keyboard
Having been on a late shift and being shattered
How expensive the weekly shop has got
Rewatching Gilmore Girls for the fourth time
deeper_things: Euthanasias really get to her, and she worries about compassion fatigue
She's anxious about money now that Callum's work is patchy, and doesn't tell her parents how tight it is
She has had counselling for anxiety through her GP and still has bad weeks
She feels guilty when she wants Callum to try harder with jobs
She sometimes wonders if she's clever enough to have gone to university
She's not sure she wants children but feels everyone expects it
card.webcam_photo: Laptop webcam at a slight upward angle from a desk, framing her from mid-chest up, a little left of centre. Lit mainly by a ceiling light and the cool glow of the screen, with a dim window off to the right showing evening. Fair skin, a few freckles, light brown hair scraped into a messy bun with strands falling at the sides. No glasses, minimal make-up. Small, slightly self-conscious closed-mouth smile. Wearing a grey hoodie over a navy T-shirt. Behind her, a magnolia wall with a small framed cross-stitch of a cat, the arm of a dark grey sofa with a folded fleece blanket, a cheap white bookshelf with paperbacks, a plant in a pot and a stack of storage boxes, and the edge of a ginger cat curled on a cushion at the bottom of the frame.
